name: William G. Resh
title: Professor and Chair, Department of Public Management and Policy
affiliation: Georgia State University, Andrew Young School of Policy Studies
summary: Resh directs CLEAR’s integrated research and education portfolio, including INSIGHT+, AI workforce modeling, research on federal workforce shocks and institutions, student collaboration, executive education programming, and is the Co-Chair of the Accountability and Reform Research Consortium (convened by the Volcker Alliance).
bio_html:
William G. Resh is a scholar of executive and bureaucratic politics, public personnel policy, civil-service systems, public management, and the U.S. presidency. His research examines how political institutions and administrative arrangements shape expertise, performance, accountability, and the public workforce.

At Georgia State University, he serves as Professor and Chair of the Department of Public Management and Policy and directs CLEAR’s research, data, education, and partnership portfolio.
